data.one_liner: Authenticate to a Solid POD server using Solid-OIDC with certified oidc.
data.what_it_does: Authenticates users to Solid POD servers using Solid-OIDC with Authorization Code and PKCE. Handles DPoP key binding and WebID issuer discovery across multiple platforms.
use_when: Building a Flutter application that needs to authenticate with Solid POD servers.
Requiring Solid-OIDC authentication with DPoP key binding and WebID discovery.
avoid_when: Building an app that requires standard OAuth providers like Google or Apple rather than Solid PODs.
strengths: Supports Solid-OIDC login across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Automates DPoP key generation and proof injection.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration of redirect URIs and client ID documents.
data.setup_notes: Requires registering redirect URIs and post-logout redirect URIs in your client ID document and configuring platform-specific URL schemes or fixed ports for desktop.
